name: Quietime
description_zh: Quietime 静夜工作室，摄影作品、影像与委托拍摄。
description_en: Quietime is a small photography studio. Personal series, short films and commissions, made slowly.
statement_zh:
夜色替我们收起喧哗，
剩下的光，才肯慢慢落进底片里。
statement_en:
After the noise of the day has gone home,
the light stays a little longer. Long enough for the film.
copyright: Copyright © Quietime Photography. All rights reserved.
home_teaser_zh: 我们拍人，也拍人离开之后留下的光。委托拍摄、商业合作与作品授权，都可以从一封邮件开始。
home_teaser_en: We photograph people, and the light they leave behind when they go. Commissions, brand work and licensing can all begin with a short letter.
about_intro_zh:
Quietime 静夜工作室相信，好的照片多半不是抓住的，而是等来的。我们习惯在人声退去之后才开始工作，给光一点时间，也给被拍的人一点时间。

工作室承接人像、空间与品牌委托，也持续进行自己的长期系列。每一次拍摄，我们都希望留下的不只是好看的画面，还有那一刻真实的温度。
about_intro_en:
Quietime believes good photographs are rarely caught. Mostly they are waited for. We tend to start once the voices have drifted off, giving the light some time, and the people in front of the camera some time as well.

The studio takes on portraits, places and brand commissions, and keeps working on long series of its own. Each time we hope to bring back more than a good-looking picture. We want the warmth that was really in the room.

services.text_zh: 在熟悉的地方慢慢拍，不赶时间。
services.text_en: Slow sessions in a place you already know well.

services.text_zh: 记录一个地方在不同光线里的样子。
services.text_en: How a place looks as the light moves through its day.

services.text_zh: 为产品和团队拍摄有呼吸感的画面。
services.text_en: Pictures of products and teams that still breathe.

services.text_zh: 作品授权、画册与展览合作。
services.text_en: Prints, books, exhibitions and image licensing.

contact_lede_zh: 告诉我们想拍什么、在哪里、大概什么时候。我们会在两天内回复，先聊想法，再谈方案。
contact_lede_en: Tell us what you have in mind, where, and roughly when. We reply within two days, and we would rather hear about the idea before we talk about the plan.

process.text_zh: 说说你想留下什么样的画面，我们一起看看参考，确定风格与地点。
process.text_en: Tell us what you would like to keep. We look at references together and settle on a mood and a place.

process.text_zh: 确认日期、时长、人数与交付内容，给出明确的报价。
process.text_en: Date, length, people and what you will receive, with a clear quote.

process.text_zh: 按约定的时间到场，不赶时间，让光和人都慢下来。
process.text_en: We arrive on time and then take our time, until the light and everyone in it have slowed down.

process.text_zh: 先发初选给你挑，再精修交付；胶片拍摄会附上扫描底片。
process.text_en: You choose from a first edit and we finish the ones you love. Film shoots come with the scanned negatives.

faq.q_en: When will the photographs be ready?
faq.a_zh: 数码拍摄一般在两周内交付精修；胶片需要冲扫，约三到四周。
faq.a_en: Digital work is usually delivered within two weeks. Film has to be developed and scanned, so allow three to four.

faq.a_zh: 可以。外地拍摄的交通与住宿另计，提前两周预约比较稳妥。
faq.a_en: Gladly. Travel and lodging are charged separately, and two weeks of notice makes everything easier.

faq.q_en: Can the photographs be used commercially?
faq.a_zh: 个人委托默认仅限个人使用；商业用途请在沟通时说明，我们会签署授权协议。
faq.a_en: Personal commissions are for personal use. If you need the pictures for commercial work, tell us early and we will put a licence in writing.

faq.q_en: How far ahead should I book?
faq.a_zh: 建议提前两到三周。节假日与黄金时段的档期紧张，越早越好。
faq.a_en: Two or three weeks is comfortable. Holidays and the golden hour go quickly, so earlier is better.

sample_credit_zh: 示例影像来自 Kodak Lossless True Color Image Suite（Kodak PhotoCD PCD0992），Eastman Kodak 公开发布，作品整理完成后替换。
sample_credit_en: Sample images from the Kodak Lossless True Color Image Suite (Kodak PhotoCD PCD0992), released by Eastman Kodak. They will be replaced by the studio archive.
